sections.title: Five ways to choose.
sections.intro: Instead of one ranking, pick the dimension that matters to you.

items.name: Best for spontaneous ideas
items.body: The shortest path from thought to record wins. Look for one-press capture that works without your phone — that's exactly what Tikpal is built for.

items.name: Best for meetings
items.body: Long, structured conversations. Prioritize dependable long recordings and meeting-oriented summaries.

items.name: Best for wearable capture
items.body: If you want it on your body, check mounting, weight and how recording starts.

items.name: Best for transcription
items.body: If the transcript is the product, compare transcription quality, languages and what's included in the price.

items.name: Best for privacy
items.body: Look for local storage, clear recording indicators and an honest data policy.
